tal-a32-p01 · verses 32.1-32.10 · WITHHELD

atha kathaye mudrāṇāṃ gurvāgamagītamatra vidhim / 0b mudrā ca pratibimbātmā śrīmaddevyākhyayāmale / uktā bimbodayaśrutyā vācyadvayavivecanāt bimbātsamudayo yasyā ityuktā pratibimbatā / vimbasya yasyā udaya ityuktā tadupāyatā mudaṃ svarūpalābhākhyaṃ dehadvāreṇa cātmanām / rātyarpayati yattena mudrā śāstreṣu varṇitā tatra pradhānabhūtā śrīkhecarī devatātmikā / niṣkalatvena vikhyātā sākalyena triśūlinī karaṅkiṇī krodhanā ca bhairavī lelihānikā / mahāpretā yogamudrā jvālinī kṣobhiṇī dhruvā ityevaṃbahubhedeyaṃ śrīkhecaryeva gīyate / anyāstadaṅgabhūtāstu padmādyā mālinīmate tāsāṃ bahutvāmukhyatvayogābhyāṃ neha varṇanam / śrīkhecarīsamāviṣṭo yadyatsthānaṃ samāśrayet devīsaṃnidhaye tatsyādalaṃ kiṃ ḍambarairvṛthā / kāmye karmaṇi tāśca syurmukhyāḥ kasyāpi jātucit mudrā caturvidhā kāyakaravākcittabhedataḥ tatra pūrṇena rūpeṇa khecarīmeva varṇaye / baddhvā padmāsanaṃ yogī nābhāvakṣeśvaraṃ kṣipet

tal-a32-p02 · verses 32.11-32.20 · WITHHELD

daṇḍākāraṃ tu taṃ tāvannayedyāvatkakhatrayam / nigṛhya tatra tattūrṇaṃ prerayet khatrayeṇa tu etāṃ baddhvā khe gatiḥ syāditi śrīpūrvaśāsane / dhvanijyotirmarudyuktaṃ cittaṃ viśramya copari anenābhyāsayogena śivaṃ bhittvā paraṃ vrajet / jatrvadhastātkarau kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ ca dakṣiṇe vidāryāsyaṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu nāsikām / anāme kuñcayetprājño bhrūbhaṅgaṃ tarjanīdvayam jihvāṃ ca cālayenmantrī hāhākāraṃ ca kārayet / triśūlena prayogeṇa brahmarandhramupasthitaḥ padaṃ santyajya tanmātraṃ sadyastyajati medinīm / śūnyāśūnyalaye kṛtvā ekadaṇḍe@nilānalau śaktitritayasambaddhe adhiṣṭhātṛtridaivate / triśūlaṃ tadvijānīyādyena vyomotpatedbudhaḥ ākāśabhāvaṃ santyajya sattāmātramupasthitaḥ / śūlaṃ samarasaṃ kṛtvā rase rasa iva sthitaḥ ekadaṇḍaṃ sa vijñāya triśūlaṃ khacaraṃ priye / baddhvā tu khecarīṃ mudrāṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ ca bhairavam khecarīcakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ sadyastyajati medinīm / tyaktāṃśako nirācāro niḥśaṅko lokavarjitaḥ

tal-a32-p03 · verses 32.21-32.30 · WITHHELD

avadhūto nirācāro nāhamasmīti bhāvayam / mantraikaniṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśyan dehasthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ hlādodvegāsmitākruṣṭanidrāmaithunamatsare / rūpādau vā kartṛkarmakaraṇeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ nāhamasmīti manvāna ekībhūtaṃ vicintayan / karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā siddhyati sphuṭam / vidyāśaṅkī malāśaṅkī śāstraśaṅkī na siddhyati śivo raviḥ śivo vahniḥ paktṛtvātsa purohitaḥ / tatrasthā devatāḥ sarvā dyotayantyo@khilaṃ jagat kaniṣṭhayā vidāryāsyaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ bhruvau tathā / anāme madhyame vaktre jihvayā tālukaṃ spṛśet eṣā karaṅkiṇī devī jvālinīṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam / hanurlalāṭagau hastau prasāryāṅgulitaḥ sphuṭau cālayedvāyuvegena kṛtvāntarbhrukuṭīṃ budhaḥ / vidāryāsyaṃ sajihvaṃ ca hāhākāraṃ tu kārayet eṣā jvālinyagnicakre tayā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam / japedyadi tataḥ siddhyettrailokyaṃ sacarācaram paradeheṣu cātmānaṃ paraṃ cātmaśarīrataḥ / paśyeccarantaṃ hānādādgamāgamapadasthitam

tal-a32-p04 · verses 32.31-32.40 · WITHHELD

navacchidragataṃ caikaṃ nadantaṃ vyāpakaṃ dhruvam / anayā hi khacārī śrīyogasañcāra ucyate kulakuṇḍalikāṃ baddhvā aṇorantaravedinīm / vāmo yo@yaṃ jagatyasmiṃstasya saṃharaṇodyatām svasthāne nirvṛtiṃ labdhvā jñānāmṛtarasātmakam / vrajetkandapadaṃ madhye rāvaṃ kṛtvā hyarāvakam yāvajjīvaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ piṇḍādhāraṃ ca kāmikam / tatra tāṃ bodhayitvā tu gatiṃ buddhvā kramāgatām cakrobhayanibaddhāṃ tu śākhāprāntāvalambinīm / mūlasthānādyathā devi tamogranthiṃ vidārayet vajrākhyāṃ jñānajenaiva tathā śākhobhayāntataḥ / koṇamadhyaviniṣkrāntaṃ liṅgamūlaṃ vibhedayet tatra saṅghaṭṭitaṃ cakrayugmamaikyena bhāsate / vaiparītyāttu nikṣipya dvidhābhāvaṃ vrajatyataḥ ūrvādyaṅguṣṭhakālāgniparyante sā vinikṣipet / gamāgamanasañcāre caretsā liṅgaliṅginī tatra tatpadasaṃyogādunmīlanavidhāyinī / yo jānāti sa siddhyettu rasādānavisargayoḥ sasaṅgamamidaṃ sthānamūrmiṇyunmīlanaṃ param / eṣa kramastato@nyo@pi vyutkramaḥ khecarī parā

tal-a32-p05 · verses 32.41-32.50 · WITHHELD

yonyādhāreti vikhyātā śūlamūleti śabdyate / varṇāstatra layaṃ yānti hyavarṇe varṇarūpiṇi nādiphāntaṃ samuccārya kauleśaṃ dehasaṃnibham / ākramya prathamaṃ cakraṃ khe yantre pādapīḍitam nādaṃ vai śaktisadgarbhaṃ sadgarbhātkaulinīpadam / bījapañcakacāreṇa śūlabhedakrameṇa tu hṛcchūlagranthibhedaiścidrudraśaktiṃ prabodhayet / vāyucakrāntanilayaṃ bindvākhyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam āgacchellambikāsthānaṃ sūtradvādaśanirgatam / candracakravilomena praviśedbhūtapañjare bhūyastu kurute līlāṃ māyāpañjaravartinīm / punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhṛtiśca khecaryā kriyate budhaiḥ śrīmadvīrāvalīyoga eṣa syātkhecarīvidhiḥ / cumbākāreṇa vaktreṇa yattattvaṃ śrūyate param grasamānamidaṃ viśvaṃ candrārkapuṭasaṃpuṭe / tenaiva syātkhagāmīti śrīmatkāmika ucyate bhavānmuktvā drāvayanti pāśānmudrā hi śaktayaḥ / mukhyāsāṃ khecarī sā ca tridhoccāreṇa vācikī triśiromudgaro devi kāyikī paripaṭhyate / nāsāṃ netradvayaṃ cāpi hṛtstanadvayameva ca

tal-a32-p06 · verses 32.51-32.60 · WITHHELD

vṛṣaṇadvayaliṅgaṃ ca prāpya kāyaṃ gatā tviyam / bhavasthānābhavasthānamuccāreṇāvadhārayet mānasīyamitastvanyāḥ padmādyā aṣṭa mudrikāḥ / mātṛvyūhakule tāḥ syurasyāstu parivāragāḥ śarīraṃ tu samastaṃ yatkūṭākṣarasamākṛti / eṣā mudrā mahāmudrā bhairavasyeti gahvare sūpaviṣṭaḥ padmake tu hastāgrāṅguliraśmibhiḥ / parāṅmukhairjhaṭityudyadraśmibhiḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaiḥ antaḥsthitiḥ khecarīyaṃ saṃkocākhyā śaśāṅkinī / tasmādeva samuttambya bāhū caivāvakuñcitau samyagvyomasu saṃsthānādvyomākhyā khecarī matā / muṣṭidvitayasaṅghaṭṭāddhṛdi sā hṛdayāhvāyā śāntākhyā sā hastayugmamūrdhvādhaḥ sthitamudgatam / samadṛṣṭyāvalokyaṃ ca bahiryojitapāṇikam eṣaiva śaktimudrā cedadhodhāvitapāṇikā / daśānāmaṅgulīnāṃ tu muṣṭibandhādanantaram drākkṣepātkhecarī devī pañcakuṇḍalinī matā / saṃhāramudrā caiṣaiva yadyūrdhvaṃ kṣipyate kila utkrāmaṇī jhagityeva paśūnāṃ pāśakartarī / śvabhre sudūre jhaṭiti svātmānaṃ pātayanniva

tal-a32-p07 · verses 32.61-32.68 · WITHHELD

sāhasānupraveśena kuñcitaṃ hastayugmakam / adhovīkṣaṇaśīlaṃ ca samyagdṛṣṭisamanvitam vīrabhairavasaṃjñeyaṃ khecarī bodhavardhinī / aṣṭadhetthaṃ varṇitā śrībhargāṣṭakaśikhākule evaṃ nānāvidhānbhedānāśrityaikaiva yā sthitā / śrīkhecarī tayāviṣṭaḥ paraṃ bījaṃ prapadyate ekaṃ sṛṣṭimayaṃ bījaṃ yadvīryaṃ sarvamantragam / ekā mudrā khecarī ca mudraughaḥ prāṇito yayā tadevaṃ khecarīcakrarūḍhau yadrūpamullaset / tadeva mudrā mantavyā śeṣaḥ syāddehavikriyā yāgādau tanmadhye tadavasitau jñānayogaparimarśe / vighnapraśame pāśacchede mudrāvidheḥ samayaḥ bodhāveśaḥ sannidhiraikyena visarjanaṃ svarūpagatiḥ / śaṅkādalanaṃ cakrodayadīptiriti kramātkṛtyam iti mudrāvidhiḥ proktaḥ sugūḍho yaḥ phalapradaḥ /
